goal: Close External Executor maintenance and exact-version security trust so only fully verified candidates can enter automatic trial and selection.
acceptance_criteria: OSV is queried only with allowlisted exact ecosystem, package, and version data.
Critical/high affected versions block; medium/low/unknown affected versions require review; clean exact-version OSV results pass.
GitHub archived, disabled, or deprecated repositories block; recent push or release can pass; stale or unavailable facts cannot auto-pass.
deps.dev advisory metadata is a conservative hint and cannot replace OSV exact-version evaluation.
Trust PASS is required before trial, and trial PASS cannot override maintenance or security REVIEW/BLOCK/UNKNOWN.
Resume checkpoints re-evaluate stale time-sensitive trust facts.
Provider, scheduling, evidence, packaging, delivery, and publication authorities remain unchanged.

quality_metrics.measure: auto-selected candidates without maintenance PASS and same-version security PASS
quality_metrics.method: offline trust-gate fixtures and integration tests

quality_metrics.measure: new agents, schedulers, executor types, formal stages, or authorities
quality_metrics.method: kernel contract and architecture regression tests

prevention: Require exact-version OSV and deterministic GitHub maintenance policy before trial
assurance: Cover every severity, fixed versions, source conflicts, no-release, stale, archived, unavailable, freshness, and trust-binding paths
control: Run scoped trust, discovery, capability, generation-lane, kernel, version, and bounded quick checks before canonical publication
improvement: Use one provider-free live trust smoke to verify all four real fact sources

interface_expectations: External Executor Discovery stays inside its current mainline position and module
OSV is one additional security fact source, not a search or acceptance authority
WorkNode external and ProviderJob concurrency contracts remain unchanged
Provider, formal evidence, local_packager, public delivery, and canonical repository publication authorities remain unchanged
evidence_refs: 146 scoped trust, discovery, capability, WorkNode, skill, generation-lane, project-plan, kernel-contract, and release-version tests passed
provider-free live trust smoke: pypdf==6.19.0, PyPI/deps.dev/GitHub/OSV reached, trust PASS, isolated trial PASS in 51.44 seconds
formal quick: TIMEOUT at the bounded 300-second limit with no scoped failure attribution

feedback: Exact-version OSV and deterministic GitHub maintenance facts now gate trial and SelectedExecutor; REVIEW, BLOCK, UNKNOWN, and stale trust cannot auto-select.
Repository-global quick remains unevaluated because the bounded profile timed out; scoped trust hardening remains separately verified.

worked: Extending the existing candidate and HTTP helper kept trust evaluation inside one module and one mainline stage.
Fixture-driven source adapters covered severity, conflict, freshness, and no-release policy without internet-dependent CI.
The real pypdf smoke verified all four sources and the trust-to-trial-to-selection chain with zero Provider calls.
did_not_work: The first regression retained the old exact allowlist assertion and failed until the guard explicitly included OSV.
The repository quick profile did not complete within its 300-second bound.
experiments: On a later bounded iteration, revalidate only expired trust facts while reusing same-version bound trial evidence.
